steps.title: The project begins
steps.description: Eterna Tech — short for Eternal Technologies — is founded in Tlemcen around a simple idea: make advanced technologies accessible to Algerian businesses.

steps.title: Setting up at the I2E Student Center
steps.description: The company moves into the I2E Student Center at the University of Tlemcen, in direct contact with the student and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

steps.title: First in-house solutions
steps.description: Work starts on Amane Trig, an AI-powered road safety device developed in-house.

steps.title: Today
steps.description: 13 services, one flagship solution developed in-house, 25+ projects delivered and 15+ satisfied clients in Algeria and beyond.
